tara-product: Quick sync 18: need signoffs for the GA readiness playbook by EOD. Top items: SLA tiers, docs checklist, oncall matrix, pricing guardrails, monitoring alerts. Who picks each?

mike-sre: Ill own oncall/alerts. Proposal: Sev1 24/7 pager, Sev2 business hours. Add rehearsal window in staging.

anya-docs: Ill own docs. Minimal sections: Whats in GA, Quickstart, API diffs, SDK examples, Rollback, Troubleshooting snippets.

beth-finance: Ill do pricing guardrails. Need baseline cost per 1M tokens, reserved discount tiers, and burst-cap policy (soft-throttle + billing cap).

sam-legal: Legal note: any SLA credit language must use our template. Fast-track if wording is deterministic. Privacy: telemetry must redact customer content.

tara-product: SLA owner? who will draft targets (p99/p50) and credit calc?

mike-sre: I can draft latency/error SLOs but need product for acceptable targets. Suggest Hosted p99 <= 250ms, Dedicated p99 <= 150ms as starting points.

beth-finance: Those targets sound reasonable for costing. Ill model cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted and post numbers.

anya-docs: Ill add a short runbook snippet to the docs for each alert and link the escalation matrix.

tara-product: Owners recap: SLA draft: mike-sre + tara-product; Docs: anya-docs; Pricing: beth-finance; Legal signoff: sam-legal; Oncall: mike-sre. If no objections by 16:00 we lock owners and open the playbook PR.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: ga-readiness-playbook-draft -> staging at 2024-06-07T17:05Z :rocket:
